summary: LifeStance Health Group filed an 8-K reporting a secondary offering of 35 million shares by selling stockholders, with the issuer repurchasing 6 million shares from the underwriter at the same price. The company received no proceeds; the closing occurred on May 12, 2026. The filing is an ordinary equity offering disclosure under Item 8.01, not a special situation. No activist, strategic review, or transformative event is present. The filing is a routine current report.
